title: Corporate Commercial Legal Secretary - Norwich
description:
Legal Secretary - Corporate Commercial Norwich Are you an experienced Legal Secretary looking for a new opportunity in Norwich? We are recruiting for a full-time, permanent Legal Secretary to join a busy and supportive Corporate Commercial team within a well-established law firm. This is an excellent opportunity for someone with previous legal secretarial experience who enjoys providing high-quality support to fee earners and wants to become part of a friendly, professional team. The Role Working closely with Corporate Commercial fee earners, your responsibilities will include:
- Providing comprehensive secretarial and administrative support
- Audio and copy typing
- Drafting, formatting and preparing legal documents and correspondence
- Assisting with case and matter preparation
- Opening, maintaining and managing client files
- Maintaining accurate records and documentation
- Assisting with billing and client accounts
- Liaising professionally with clients and third parties
- Supporting the wider team with day-to-day administration

What We're Looking For You will ideally have:
- Previous Legal Secretary experience
- Corporate Commercial experience would be advantageous, although not essential
- Excellent typing, IT and Microsoft Office skills
- Strong organisational and time-management abilities
- Excellent attention to detail
- Confident written and verbal communication skills
- A professional, friendly and approachable manner
- The ability to work independently while also contributing to a team environment

Position DetailsLocation: NorwichHours: 35 hours per week, Monday to Friday, 9:00am-5:00pmContract: Full-time, permanentSalary: Competitive, dependent on experienceBenefits The firm offers an excellent benefits package, including:
- Profit-share bonus
- Bupa cash plan health cover
- Enhanced pension
- Death in service benefit
- Discounted personal legal services
- Generous annual leave entitlement
- Regular social events
- Supportive and friendly working environment

If you're an experienced Legal Secretary in Norwich looking for a permanent opportunity within a Corporate Commercial law team, I'd be very happy to have a confidential conversation about the role.Apply today or get in touch to find out more.

title: Legal Secretary / Legal PA
company: KC LEGAL RECRUITMENT LIMITED - Agency - Permanent
description:
Legal Secretaries / Legal PA's - Norwich

Are you an experienced Legal Secretary looking for your next opportunity in Norwich?

I'm currently recruiting on behalf of several well-established law firms in Norwich, with a range of opportunities available across a number of specialist legal teams.

We're looking to speak with Legal Secretaries and Legal PA's who are organised, proactive and confident supporting busy fee earners in a professional legal environment.

Current opportunities include:
- Property - supporting busy residential property teams
- Private Client - working alongside solicitors dealing with wills, probate, trusts and estate planning
- Court of Protection - providing secretarial and administrative support within a specialist COP team
- Agricultural & Estates - supporting solicitors working with rural, agricultural and estate-related matters

What we're looking for

You may already be working as a Legal Secretary / Legal PA, Legal Assistant or within another legal support role and be looking for your next challenge.

We're particularly interested in candidates who have:
- Previous experience within a legal environment
- Excellent organisational and administrative skills
- Strong attention to detail
- Good written and verbal communication skills
- The ability to manage deadlines and prioritise a busy workload
- A professional, proactive and positive approach

Legal experience within one of the areas above is advantageous, but transferable legal secretarial experience will also be considered.

What's on offer?

Each firm offers a slightly different working environment and benefits package, but all opportunities provide the chance to join established legal teams and develop your career within the Norwich legal market.

Salaries are competitive and will reflect your level of experience and the requirements of the role. These opportunities are full time positions, Monday - Friday 9am - 5pm.

If you're a Legal Secretary / Legal PA and your considering your next move, I'd love to hear from you.

Please apply now, or contact Kylee Curson-Eames at KC Legal Recruitment for a confidential discussion about the opportunities.
